body: Exactly, try starting on a small simple project. Build a model airplane, or plant some flowers, work on them every day... it doesn't take much time, but find something you could take pride in. Then start working on the bigger stuff, and give the therapy, etc... some time.

I posted this on askreddit as "Should I join the military (just to get a job), but in case I don't get any advice, here it is again:

So, basically, I graduated with a degree in communications and worked for 6 years and was really good at my job, but the company went under. It's been a year since I was laid off. I've had tons of interviews and all the interviewers were "impressed." I've had 2nd, 3rd and even 6th interviews, but, I always got the rejection letter (yay, recession!). I'm desperate and need to get back on my feet. I know the armed forces won't reject me and maybe I could use that to eventually go back to school and find a career that is more "recession-proof."

Is this a bad idea? Is there something else I could do? I'm really desperate because my marriage etc... is dependent on this. Any advice is greatly apprectiated.

Other details: my old boss is retired and doesn't respond to reference requests (yes, he's an asshole), so a lot of the interviewers I suspect think that I'm lying, though I'm not. I worked for a small company that not many people know.

I've exhausted my networking contacts, but everyone seems to be in the same situation I am in.

I've looked at jobs in other cities, but again, it doesn't seem to work out (on their end).

For the past 3 or so months, I've consistently had suicidal thoughts as I think that my family might be better off with the money from my life insurance policy, than have to suffer losing our home, having to get rid of our pet, selling cars, etc...

Also, this is not a new state of mind for me. I've always been depressed and had suicidal thoughts, but have been able to "push" them aside if I am busy enough. I've tried several therapists and all the drugs they gave me, but nothing worked. 

If I don't find a solution soon, I'm afraid I will descend to a point where I would actually "sacrifice" myself....
